''''Water Rat' Jorgy''' is a human member of the [[Southsea Freebooters]] located at the [[Bright Coast]] in [[Lapidis Isle]]. [[Sergeant Blackwell]] wants him dead for his part in sinking the [[Kul Tiran Exploratory Fleet]]'s ships on the isle.

==Objective of==
* Drops [[Head of Jorgy]] for {{questlong|Alliance|54|The Water Rat}}.
